Heroic warm blood and healing after successful block; no fire, no flames, no blood loss or wound. Dark navy/green backdrop.
provenance.caption: Успешный блок запускает восстановление: сердце и последовательные зелёные частицы.

provenance.name: Громкий триумф
provenance.subject: Silver armored fist raises a straight steel/brass sword vertically in victory, burgundy cloth at wrist. Strong gold rays fan OUT behind upper blade without becoming fire. Proud powerful upward silhouette, tiny cracked enemy crown near lower corner. No timer, count, numbers or stacks; reward duration unspecified. Dark wine/navy.
provenance.caption: Поднятый меч и золотые лучи обозначают наступательное усиление после победы.

provenance.name: Идеальный рывок
provenance.subject: Silver/burgundy warrior moving swiftly to upper right with long silver-cyan trailing streaks. Thin GOLD protective contour hugs the entire leading body silhouette, with one incoming dark shard dispersing harmlessly just outside contour. No sword strike or dome; readable enhanced protected dash. Dark navy. The warrior has uncovered short brown hair and blue eyes, no helmet; silver/brass armor and burgundy cape match the accepted character.
provenance.caption: Усиленный рывок: длинный след и золотой защитный контур вокруг героя.

provenance.name: Разящий удар
provenance.subject: One straight silver/brass sword held at lower left strikes a large dark enemy helmet at upper right, with TWO smaller adjacent enemy helmets behind it caught in a short white/cyan outward contact spray from the blade edge. Clear main target plus nearby splash, no circle or lightning or projectile. Dark navy.
provenance.caption: Попадание по основной цели с коротким сплэшем по соседним противникам.

provenance.name: Закалённый клинок
provenance.subject: Silver sword held by burgundy-gripped gauntlet; a red pinpoint at upper blade edge releases a few small emerald life motes curving back DOWN toward the hero's hand, clear healing-from-sword-contact symbol. Steel blade remains silver, no melting/fire. One subtle green glow near wrist, navy background.
provenance.caption: Лечение от атак: зелёные частицы жизни возвращаются от клинка к владельцу.

provenance.name: Вихревое рассечение
provenance.subject: Small central silver-and-burgundy warrior with right arm extending a silver sword outward. A bright cyan/white circular motion arc rotates AROUND THE CHARACTER at the radius of the sword's OUTER EDGE, interrupted by the leading sword tip. Blade extends radially from hand toward ring; ring centred on torso, never at hilt. Strong spiral spin around body, dark navy. The warrior has uncovered short brown hair and blue eyes, no helmet; silver/brass armor and burgundy cape match the accepted character.
provenance.caption: Круговой след проходит вокруг Воина на радиусе режущей части меча.

provenance.name: Широкий выпад
provenance.subject: A forward-lunging silver/burgundy warrior at right side of icon ends a long dash; faint straight pale speed streaks trail far behind left, but sword slash exists ONLY at destination around extended sword blade ahead of him. One bright partial white/cyan frontal crescent at endpoint, none along movement trail. Dark navy, coherent single pose. The warrior has uncovered short brown hair and blue eyes, no helmet; silver/brass armor and burgundy cape match the accepted character.
provenance.caption: Длинный выпад и один фронтальный удар в конечной точке.
